item.title: Constraints Create Challenge
item.description: Another parable: golf is a game with the goal of putting a ball in a hole. That would be easy and boring if you could just pick it up and drop it in.

item.title: Controlled Perspective
item.description: Dark rides — Disney’s Haunted Mansion, classic Pirates of the Caribbean — exploit the visitor’s constrained position to control pacing, stage surprises, and pull off visual tricks that only work from one angle: the hollow-mask illusion, infinity mirrors, Pepper’s ghost.
